Do you like to roll up your sleeves? 

And are you looking for a flexible job that fits your lifestyle?

Then SD Worx Jobs is the right place for you

SD Worx Jobs is looking for a logistics associate for a client located in Kruisem. 

Your tasks will be as follows:

• Helping to prepare orders with a scanning system

• Packing goods

• Labelling and marking 

• Performing quality checks

• You speak and understand English.

• Preferably, you have experience as an order picker.

Our client is an international animal health organization operating in a dynamic and fast-growing environment. The company combines global expertise with local market impact and offers employees the opportunity to influence business development within a specialized sector.

Jobomschrijving

As a successful Veterinary Services Manager Poultry - Benelux, you will have the following responsibilities:

• Provide technical and scientific support to poultry customers (farmers, veterinary clinics & veterinarians) and partners.
• Build and maintain relationships with veterinarians, farmers, and key stakeholders.
• Act as the poultry technical expert for the Benelux market.
• Support commercial teams with technical product knowledge and customer insights.
• Deliver training sessions to customers, veterinarians, and internal teams.
• Develop and maintain a strong network of Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs).
• Support product launches and market development initiatives.
• Analyze field data and provide solutions to customer challenges.

As a successful Veterinary Services Manager Poultry - Benelux, you will have the following profile:

• Degree in Veterinary Medicine preferred; strong poultry expertise is essential.
• Experience in poultry production, veterinary practice, or animal health.
• Strong technical affinity and willingness to learn.
• Commercial mindset
• Hands-on, proactive, and adaptable mindset.
• Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
• Fluent in English and at least an intermediate level of Dutch and/or French 
• Comfortable with regular travel across the Benelux region and occasional European meetings.

Ready to start straight away in a full-time meat production role near Oosterzele, with no weekend shifts? Explore this opportunity in food production.

A food production workplace focused on meat products.

What you’ll do

For our client, an international company specialized in the management, maintenance and rental of Ground Support Equipment (GSE) for the aviation industry, we are looking for a experienced motivated Welder / Mechanical Assembler. 
As a Welder / Mechanical Assembler, you will be responsible for carrying out welding and metal fabrication work, as well as repairing mechanical components of non-motorized Ground Support Equipment (GSE). You will ensure that all work is performed safely, efficiently and in accordance with technical specifications and quality standards.

Your Responsibilities 
 

 
• Perform welding work using MIG, TIG, stick (electrode) welding and other welding techniques on GSE equipment. 
 

 
• Repair cracks, reinforce structures and manufacture custom metal components. 
 

 
• Assemble and install mechanical parts and components. 
 

 
• Install, adjust and maintain hydraulic and pneumatic systems. 
 

 
• Read and interpret technical drawings and engineering plans. 
 

 
• Carry out inspections and preventive maintenance on welded structures and mechanical components. 
 

 
• Repair and maintain locks, locking mechanisms and other mechanical systems. 
 

 
• Inspect completed work to ensure quality standards are met and provide technical support to colleagues when required. 
 

 
• Properly use and maintain welding equipment, tools and workshop machinery. 
 

 
• Comply with all health, safety and quality procedures. 
 

 
• Record completed work, repairs and material usage accurately. 
 
•  
Work closely with colleagues from the mechanical, electrical and workshop departments to ensure efficient maintenance and repair operations.

 
• You have at least 5 years of experience as a welder and/or mechanical assembler, preferably within the aviation, automotive or heavy industrial sector. 
 

 
• You have a solid knowledge of MIG, TIG and stick (electrode) welding techniques. 
 

 
• You have experience with metal fabrication, construction work and mechanical assembly. 
 

 
• You can confidently read and interpret technical drawings and blueprints. 
 

 
• You understand the properties of different materials and their behaviour during welding and repair work. 
 

 
• You are accurate, quality-driven and committed to working safely. 
 

 
• You are a reliable team player with a strong sense of responsibility. 
 

 
• You have a good command of the English language. 
 

 
• You hold a valid Category B driving licence. 
 
•  
A forklift certificate is considered an advantage. 

 
• You are willing to obtain an airport security badge and airport driving permit.

jobs.occupation: Electromechanical Technician - motors & machinery | Brucargo | ENG
jobs.description:
For a technical maintenance company operating at the airport, we are looking for a Electromechanical Technician – Motors & Machinery. As a Electromechanical Technician – Motors & Machinery, you will be responsible for the maintenance, repair, and servicing of electrical systems on a wide range of Ground Support Equipment (GSE), including pushback tractors, baggage tractors, belt loaders, GPU units, passenger steps, and other motorized vehicles. You will ensure that all electrical systems operate safely, efficiently, and in compliance with current standards.

Your responsibilities include:
 

 
•  
 Performing maintenance, repair, and servicing of electrical systems on GSE equipment (pushback tractors, baggage tractors, belt loaders, GPU units, passenger steps, etc.). 

 
• Troubleshooting and resolving faults in electrical and electronic assemblies. 
 
• Installing, testing, and commissioning electrical systems according to current safety standards and regulations. 
 

 
• Documenting maintenance and repair activities and contributing to technical reports. 
 
•  
Providing on-the-job training to other mechanics on troubleshooting and complex electrical systems. 

 
• Ensuring compliance with legal regulations, safety standards, and quality assurance guidelines. 
 
•  
Keeping tools, equipment, and test devices in good working condition through routine checks and cleaning. 

 
• Preparing equipment for handover to customers or deployment on airport sites. 
 

 
• Coordinating with mechanical, electrical, and workshop technicians to ensure efficient and safe execution of repair and maintenance tasks. 

 
• Completed vocational training as an industrial electrician, electronics technician for industrial engineering, mechatronics technician, or a comparable qualification. 
 
• Extensive experience in the maintenance and repair of electrical systems, ideally in aviation or a related technical field. 
 
• Experience with high voltage equipment, preferably with certification. 
 
• Extensive knowledge of control technology and proficiency in reading circuit diagrams. 
 
• Excellent communication skills to report issues and collaborate with other workshop personnel. 
 
• Good command of local language as well as English language, both spoken and written. 
 
• Class B driving license, additional driving permits are an advantage. 
 
• Possess or are eligible to obtain an airport security pass and an airport driving permit.

Do you have a passion for technology and would you like to work at a unique, international location? For our client, active at Brussels Airport, we are looking for a motivated Maintenance Technician who enjoys working on challenging and diverse technical equipment.

As a Maintenance Technician, you will be responsible for the maintenance and repairs of motorized rolling equipment (Ground Support Equipment). You will work both in the workshop and, after a thorough training period, airside. No two days are the same: you will join a dynamic environment with impressive machines and technical challenges.

Your responsibilities:
 

 
• You carry out maintenance and repairs on mechanical, hydraulic and basic electrical systems (such as engines, brakes, axles, ...). 
 
•  
You perform dismantling and assembly work according to technical documentation and machine instructions. 

 
• You check the operation of systems and troubleshoot technical issues. 
 

 
• You report technical problems to the Workshop Supervisor. 
 
•  
You repair or replace defective components. 

 
• You support colleagues with larger projects and urgent interventions. 
 
•  
You contribute to safe, high-quality and efficient work.

 
• You have at least a secondary education diploma in a technical field (mechanics or a similar discipline). 
 
•  
Experience with rolling equipment is a plus, but not required. A strong interest in technology is more important. 

 
•  
You have basic knowledge of electricity or are willing to learn more about it. 

 
•  
You can communicate fluently in English. Knowledge of Dutch and/or French is a nice asset. 

 
• You have a valid driving licence B.

jobs.occupation: All-Round Maintenance Technician (2-Shift or Night Shift)
jobs.description:
Your responsibilities as an All-Round Maintenance Technician:
 

 
• Diagnose and resolve mechanical and electromechanical breakdowns in a production environment.
 
• Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on machines and installations.
 
• Assist with technical projects and continuous improvement initiatives.
 
• Carry out TIG welding on stainless steel structures and components.
 
• Connect, maintain, and repair motors, drives, and control systems.
 
• Support various technical activities within the maintenance department.
 
• Occasionally travel using a company vehicle. 

Who are you?
 

 
• You have knowledge of mechanics and electrical systems (motors, sensors, etc.).
 
• Experience with TIG welding of stainless steel is a plus.
 
• You enjoy working in a team and have a hands-on mentality.
 
• You are eager to learn and further develop your technical skills.
 
• You speak either Dutch or English fluently.
 
• You are flexible and willing to transition from a daytime training period to a 2-shift system or a permanent night shift:
 
• Early shift: 5:48 AM - 2:00 PM
 
• Late shift: 1:48 PM - 10:00 PM
 
• Night shift: 9:48 PM - 6:00 AM
 
• Experience with a forklift and/or aerial work platform is an advantage. If you do not yet hold the required certificates, you are willing to obtain them.

For a growing technical organization in the logistics sector, we are looking for a motivated Maintenance Technician who wants to contribute to the reliability and efficiency of industrial installations. As a Maintenance Technician, under the supervision of a supervisor, you will be responsible for the proper functioning of automated sorting systems and conveyor lines. 
Your responsibilities include: 

 
• Carrying out preventive maintenance according to the CMMS plan (Computerized Maintenance Management System). 
 
•  
Quickly and efficiently detecting and resolving technical faults. 

 
•  
Making technical improvement proposals based on your experience with breakdowns. 

 
• Advising your supervisor on technical optimizations. 
 
•  
Preparing intervention reports and correctly registering activities in the CMMS system. 

 
•  
Managing stock and following up on spare parts. 

 
•  
Training and supporting users in carrying out first-line maintenance. 

 
• Providing technical support to the operational teams. 

In the long term, you will also work in the Vilvoorde region.

 
• You hold a technical secondary education (TSO) or Bachelor's degree in electromechanics, industrial electricity, or automation. 
 

 
• You have broad technical knowledge of mechanics, electricity, automation, and pneumatics. 
 

 
• You have experience with industrial IT and CMMS systems. 
 
•  
Knowledge of sorting systems or conveyor systems is a plus. 

 
• You are fluent in English and either French or Dutch.

Our client, located in the Beveren region, is looking for a Supervisor Piping & Mechanical with strong technical expertise and people leadership skills.
 
 

• You’ll lead, coordinate and supervise daily piping and mechanical maintenance activities with a strong focus on HSE, quality, cost control and operational continuity 

• You’ll plan, prioritize and allocate maintenance work to ensure efficient execution of both preventive and corrective maintenance activities 

• You’ll organize daily toolbox meetings, communicate priorities and ensure compliance with all safety procedures and permit-to-work requirements 

• You’ll actively supervise field activities and provide technical support to technicians and contractors during the execution of maintenance work 

• You’ll coordinate closely with Operations, Engineering, Reliability and Inspection departments to align maintenance priorities and ensure efficient plant availability 

• You’ll ensure the safe and efficient execution of maintenance activities on piping systems, pressure vessels, heat exchangers, storage tanks and other static equipment 

• You’ll safeguard the mechanical integrity of plant assets by ensuring that maintenance and repair activities are executed according to engineering standards, site procedures and applicable regulations 

• You’ll support inspection programs and follow up on findings, integrity assessments, statutory inspections and corrective actions 

• You’ll coordinate and manage external contractors, ensuring compliance with safety, quality, planning and budget requirements 

• You’ll monitor work quality and verify that repairs, modifications and installations are completed according to specifications and industry standards 

• You’ll support the preparation, execution and evaluation of shutdowns, turnarounds and maintenance projects 

• You’ll drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on reliability, safety, efficiency and maintenance performance 

• You’ll ensure accurate maintenance administration and reporting in SAP, including work order completion, time registration and maintenance history 
 

• You have a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a comparable technical qualification, or equivalent by experience 

• You have at least 5 years of relevant maintenance experience within the petrochemical, chemical, oil & gas or related process industry 

• You’re experienced in a supervisory, team leader or coordination role within an industrial environment 

• You have solid knowledge of piping systems, pressure equipment, heat exchangers, storage tanks and other static equipment 

• You have a good understanding of mechanical integrity principles, inspection methodologies and reliability-driven maintenance practices 

• You have a strong knowledge of HSE requirements, permit-to-work systems, contractor management and process safety 

• You’re experienced with SAP or another CMMS system and good proficiency in Microsoft Office applications 

• You own strong planning, organizational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to effectively manage changing priorities 

• You have excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, enabling effective collaboration across multiple disciplines 

• You are fluent in Dutch and have a good command of English 

• You have a hands-on leadership style with the ability to motivate, coach and develop people

Toyota is one of the world’s largest automobile manufacturers and a leading global corporation. Founded in 1937. Toyota now sells vehicles in 170 countries and employs over 350.000 people. Based in Brussels, Belgium, and staffed by 2.700 people and more than 60 nationalities, Toyota Motor Europe (TME) handles the wholesale marketing of Toyota and Lexus vehicles, parts & accessories, and manages Toyota’s European R&D, manufacturing, and engineering operations.

The company is excited to be transforming into a mobility company focusing on bringing even more happiness to our customers through various mobility solutions.

Jobomschrijving

Marketing Campaign Support

• Support the end-to-end planning and execution of integrated marketing campaigns for vehicle launches model year updates, special editions, and brand-building initiatives.
• Assist in developing campaign briefs by gathering market insights, target audience information, competitive intelligence, and product-related content.
• Coordinate with cross-functional teams including Product Management, Digital, Launch team, Public Relations, and external agencies to ensure campaign alignment and timely execution.
• Contribute to the development of campaign messaging and customer value propositions that effectively communicate vehicle features, technologies, and brand differentiators.
• Help manage the campaign timeline, ensuring deliverables are completed according to project milestones and launch schedules.

• Support the management of campaign budgets by tracking expenditures, processing purchase orders, and maintaining records of marketing investments.

Digital Marketing

• Support to the digital team to create the digital content and website.

Events and Product Launches

• Assist in organizing pan European vehicle launches activities.

Reporting and Administration

Your profile

• 3 to 7 years of experience in Marketing
• Experience in coordination with agencies is a must have
• Strong organisational skills and attention to detail
• Proactive, structured and able to manage multiple priorities
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills
• Fluent in English (additional European languages are an asset)
• Proficient in MS Office (PowerPoint, Excel)
Your Competencies

• Planning & organisation
• Teamwork and collaboration
• Communication
• Attention to detail
• Proactivity

jobs.occupation: Order picker in day shift - open to English speakers!
jobs.description:
Are you already familiar with orderpicking and logistics? And are you looking for a stable and physically engaging role with job security? And do you like great hours to get a good work-life balance? Then this is an excellent opportunity for you!

For a large and growing logistics in Oostkamp specialised in frozen goods, we're looking for an orderpicker to join the day shift team in the freezer warehouse. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an orderpicker, you play a crucial part in the company’s logistical process. You work in the freezer every day to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

• Making orders based on order lists

• Preparing completed orders for shipment

• Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks

You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work

• Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment

• Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)

Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

!! Please note: you already need to live in Belgium for this job, preferably in the region of Oostkamp or Bruges. Actief cannot help you immigrate nor provide housing. If you don't have an official address in Belgium you do not qualify !!

Test Engineer (Freelance) - Namur

On behalf of one of our clients, we are looking for a Test Engineer to join a software development team working in Scrum. You will be involved throughout the development lifecycle, from refining user stories to release into production. The role combines functional testing and test automation.

 

Your responsibilities

• Take part in agile ceremonies and in workshops that define acceptance criteria written in Gherkin

• Design test scenarios based on business and technical requirements, prioritising by risk

• Run functional, integration, regression, end-to-end and exploratory tests

• Develop the test automation framework (UI, API, regression) and integrate it into the CI/CD pipeline

• Test REST APIs: contracts, error handling, authentication and data consistency

• Contribute to performance testing when needed

• Log and track defects, and support developers until they are resolved

• Report clear metrics on test progress and release quality

Your profile

• At least 3 years of experience in software testing or QA in an agile environment

• Solid command of BDD (Cucumber or equivalent)

• Hands-on experience with test automation (Selenium or a similar tool) and API testing (Postman/Newman or equivalent)

• Familiarity with Jira (ideally Xray), Git and CI/CD pipelines

• Knowledge of performance testing (JMeter, Gatling...) is a plus

• ISTQB Foundation certification is appreciated

• Analytical mindset, attention to detail and the ability to communicate with both technical and business stakeholders

• Fluent French is mandatory. English is an asset.

What we offer

• Contract: freelance

• Duration: long-term assignment

• Location: Namur, with 2 days of remote work per week

Interested? Send us your CV.
